paragraphs: 2 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Friday for 2 clubs, with Brooks Lee producing the night's most notable performance.
Brooks Lee produced a lineout in the second toward second base on a 1-0 97 mph four-seam fastball from Jacob deGrom.
He batted second and started at third base.

Andrew Alvarez started on the mound for Washington Nationals. He worked 4 2/3 innings, allowing 7 hits and 5 earned runs, with 3 walks and 7 strikeouts. One of his strikeouts came in the second on a 2-2 92 mph four-seam fastball, when he put away Marcus Semien. Washington Nationals beat New York Mets, 7-6.
title: Brooks Lee highlights a busy Friday for former Mustangs
